title: Code and data for: How Much Do Mountains Matter? Revisiting the Kaplan-DeMaria Model for Terrain-Dependent Tropical Cyclone Wind Decay in the Philippines
description:
Analysis scripts, derived datasets, per-fold predictions and result tables supporting Zerrudo and Servando, submitted to Weather and Forecasting (WAF-D-26-0060).

Symbolic regression applied to 453 native 6-hourly overland points from 121 Philippine tropical cyclone landfalls (1977-2022) recovers V(t) = V0[1 - a(V0 t + h)], with h the mean bare-earth elevation within a 75 km circle. Storm-stratified five-fold cross-validation gives 9.22 kt against 9.86 kt for the constant-rate baseline.

IBTrACS and the NAMRIA IfSAR digital terrain model are not redistributed here.
